opj-degenerate-1px-tile-column.note: Degenerate geometry: OpenJPEG 2.5.4 does not reproduce its own lossless input at x=66 (opjEqualsEncoderInput=false); the 1-pixel tile column (exemptColumnsX) is excluded from the comparison; every other sample must match opj_decompress exactly

opj-poc-tiled.note: opj_compress keeps only the first tile POC (res 0-2 of 4): the stream omits packets. OpenJPEG decodes it leniently, so this is NOT an OpenJPEG-validated expectation: this decoder deliberately rejects POC ranges that leave packets uncovered (policy, no normative sentence is cited; tests/fixtures/jpx poc-malformed-* depend on it)

opj-subsampled-3x2-odd.note: Input-equality not asserted: OpenJPEG decoded plane dims/values differ from the generator model for subsampled raw input; the reference is opj_decompress output.

opj-subsampled-255.note: Input-equality not asserted: OpenJPEG decoded plane dims/values differ from the generator model for subsampled raw input; the reference is opj_decompress output.

opj-surgery-coc-qcc-identity.note: COC/QCC repeat COD/QCD for every component

opj-surgery-derived-quant.note: syntactically valid scalar-derived QCD over a stream coded with expounded steps (step sizes and Mb change); output is whatever OpenJPEG decodes

opj-surgery-guard-bits+1.note: guard-bit field rewritten after encoding (changes Mb); output is whatever OpenJPEG decodes

opj-surgery-guard-bits-1.note: guard-bit field rewritten after encoding (changes Mb); output is whatever OpenJPEG decodes

outOfScope.depth>16: opj_compress RAW input is limited to 16 bits per sample; a >16-bit PGX writer would be needed (no OpenJPEG-produced >16-bit codestream is available here), so >16-bit handling is covered only by hand-built codestreams in JpxConformanceTests.
outOfScope.PPM/PPT single-tile via surgery: make_jpx_fixtures.pack_packet_headers only handles one-code-block packets, so opj_compress streams cannot be repackaged.
outOfScope.PLM: no OpenJPEG encoder option; decoders ignore it. Covered by tests/fixtures/jpx (see make_jpx_fixtures.py).
outOfScope.PPM/PPT multi-tile/multi-part: covered by tests/fixtures/jpx fixtures (decoded by OpenJPEG through Pillow); only the single-tile forms are regenerated here.
outOfScope.fewer layers/resolutions decode: the decoder API always decodes every layer/resolution (PDF requires it); opj_decompress -l/-r references would have no counterpart.
outOfScope.JPX Part 2 extensions: must fail gracefully; no OpenJPEG encoder exists. Out of scope for generated fixtures.
outOfScope.scalar-derived/guard-bits as encoder out: opj_compress always writes none (5/3) or expounded (9/7) with 2 guard bits; the derived/guard variants are marker surgery whose pixels are still decoded by opj_decompress.
